checklist_items.title: Next.js Setup và Project Structure
checklist_items.description: create-next-app, App Router directory structure, file conventions (page, layout, loading, error, not-found), next.config.js, .env
checklist_items.market_relevance: Next.js là React framework phổ biến nhất cho production apps

checklist_items.title: App Router và File-based Routing
checklist_items.description: page.tsx, layout.tsx, dynamic routes ([id]), catch-all ([...slug]), route groups ((marketing)), parallel routes (@slot), Link component, useRouter, usePathname
checklist_items.market_relevance: App Router là core feature của Next.js 13+

checklist_items.title: Server Components vs Client Components
checklist_items.description: 'use client' và 'use server' directives, khi nào dùng mỗi loại, passing data từ server xuống client, serializable data constraint, composition patterns
checklist_items.market_relevance: RSC là paradigm shift trong React/Next.js — phải hiểu rõ

checklist_items.title: Data Fetching trong Server Components
checklist_items.description: async/await trong Server Components, fetch() với caching options, request memoization với cache(), parallel data fetching, sequential vs parallel
checklist_items.market_relevance: Data fetching là workflow cơ bản nhất trong Next.js

checklist_items.title: Next.js Image và Font Optimization
checklist_items.description: next/image (priority, sizes, fill, remote patterns), next/font (Google Fonts self-hosting, font-display, variable fonts), preload, CLS prevention
checklist_items.market_relevance: Image và font optimization ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến Core Web Vitals

checklist_items.title: Metadata API và SEO
checklist_items.description: export metadata, generateMetadata(), title templates, Open Graph, Twitter Card, canonical, robots, sitemap.ts, opengraph-image.tsx, JSON-LD
checklist_items.market_relevance: SEO-first là lý do chính dùng Next.js thay vì CRA

checklist_items.title: Route Handlers và API Routes
checklist_items.description: app/api/route.ts, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE exports, Web Request/Response API, cookies(), headers(), Edge runtime, NextResponse
checklist_items.market_relevance: Route Handlers là backend layer của Next.js apps

checklist_items.title: Server Actions và Mutations
checklist_items.description: 'use server', form action, useFormState, useFormStatus, useOptimistic, revalidatePath/revalidateTag, redirect, error handling
checklist_items.market_relevance: Server Actions simplify full-stack development trong Next.js

checklist_items.title: Caching Strategy
checklist_items.description: 4 caching layers, fetch cache options (revalidate, no-store, force-cache), unstable_cache, on-demand revalidation, cache tags, router cache
checklist_items.market_relevance: Understanding caching là key để build performant Next.js apps

checklist_items.title: Streaming và Suspense
checklist_items.description: loading.tsx auto Suspense, nested Suspense boundaries, streaming HTML, parallel data fetching với Suspense, skeleton UIs
checklist_items.market_relevance: Streaming dramatically improves perceived performance

checklist_items.title: Authentication với Auth.js (NextAuth)
checklist_items.description: Auth.js v5 setup, OAuth providers (Google/GitHub), credentials provider, session strategy, middleware protection, useSession, signIn/signOut Server Actions
checklist_items.market_relevance: Auth là requirement cho 90% production Next.js apps

checklist_items.title: Middleware
checklist_items.description: middleware.ts, NextRequest/NextResponse, matcher config, auth redirect, geolocation, A/B testing, rewrite vs redirect, cookies/headers in middleware
checklist_items.market_relevance: Middleware là powerful tool cho edge-level logic

checklist_items.title: Next.js với Database — Prisma/Drizzle
checklist_items.description: Prisma Client singleton pattern, type-safe queries, migrations, connection pooling cho serverless, Prisma Accelerate, edge-compatible databases
checklist_items.market_relevance: Database integration là full-stack skill quan trọng

checklist_items.title: Error Handling và Not Found
checklist_items.description: error.tsx, global-error.tsx, not-found.tsx, notFound(), error.reset(), ErrorBoundary, logging errors to external service
checklist_items.market_relevance: Proper error handling là thiết yếu cho UX và debugging

checklist_items.title: Hydration và Debugging
checklist_items.description: Hydration errors, suppressHydrationWarning, dynamic() với ssr:false, browser-only code patterns, useEffect cho client-only state
checklist_items.market_relevance: Hydration bugs là common pain point trong Next.js

checklist_items.title: Performance Optimization
checklist_items.description: @next/bundle-analyzer, dynamic imports, lazy loading, partial prerendering (PPR), prefetch, React.memo trong Next.js context
checklist_items.market_relevance: Performance optimization là differentiator cho Next.js apps

checklist_items.title: Edge Runtime và Vercel Deployment
checklist_items.description: Edge runtime vs Node.js runtime, cold starts, Vercel Analytics, Speed Insights, regions, Vercel Edge Config, ISR on Vercel
checklist_items.market_relevance: Vercel là platform tối ưu nhất cho Next.js

checklist_items.title: OG Images với ImageResponse
checklist_items.description: opengraph-image.tsx, ImageResponse, JSX trong image, custom fonts, dynamic content, Twitter Card images, caching
checklist_items.market_relevance: Dynamic OG images tăng click-through rate trên social media

checklist_items.title: Internationalization (i18n)
checklist_items.description: App Router i18n với [lang] segment, middleware locale detection, getDictionary pattern, generateStaticParams for locales, next-intl library
checklist_items.market_relevance: i18n là requirement cho global applications

checklist_items.title: Monitoring và Observability
checklist_items.description: OpenTelemetry với instrumentation.ts, Sentry integration, Vercel Analytics, structured logging với Pino, custom Web Vitals tracking
checklist_items.market_relevance: Observability là thiết yếu cho production systems
